description.value: Fresh Tracks Café is the day lodge restaurant at Whitewater Mountain Resort in the Selkirk Mountains near Nelson, celebrated for creative, wholesome meals that defy typical ski-hill cafeteria expectations. Former co-owner Shelley Adams built an international cult following through a health-conscious, versatile menu that spawned four globally best-selling cookbooks still sold at the resort. The open-concept eatery accommodates a wide range of dietary needs, with many menu items adaptable for vegan, celiac, and other sensitivities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Fresh Tracks Café as the day lodge restaurant at Whitewater Mountain Resort, explicitly listing washrooms as a day lodge amenity and noting broad dietary accommodation (vegan, celiac, other sensitivities). The resort's Facts & Stats page states 'Cell Service/Wifi None,' corroborating the OSM internet_access=no tag. No bike-specific infrastructure is mentioned anywhere in the website content, and no summer operating information was found for Fresh Tracks specifically, raising seasonal accessibility concerns for touring cyclists.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records the name as 'Fresh Tracks Cafe Express' but the website consistently uses 'Fresh Tracks Café' without 'Express' in all headings and body text.

Likely ski-season only: no summer hours or summer operating information found for Fresh Tracks Café. The resort's summer food offering (Hummingbird Lodge Café) has documented summer hours, but Fresh Tracks does not.
Physical location is at Whitewater Ski Resort (~20 km from Nelson on Whitewater Road), not in Nelson — the mountain road approach may be impractical for most loaded touring cyclists.
No phone or street address in OSM; phone numbers on the contact page (250-354-4944, 800-666-9420) are for the resort's downtown Nelson office, not the café directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The café is located at a ski resort day lodge approximately 20 km from Nelson on a mountain road and appears to operate primarily during ski season; no summer operating information was found for Fresh Tracks specifically, making its accessibility to touring cyclists uncertain.
